title: Menstrual regulation, fertilization and pregnancy
source_evidence: Complete L46–47 publisher captions and all 36 assigned topics, including late exercises, read. Prior bounded source intake: seven contact sheets, 129 sampled stills and 29 native reopens; no continuous audio/video or claim of a new author frame audit.

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain ovarian versus uterine events with two synchronized tracks. Caption says a 21-day total at 01:33 and “day 18 or day 14” at 02:11, while later slides use a model 28-day cycle. Correct the inconsistency; day 1 is first menstrual bleeding.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain follicular/ovulatory/luteal partition. Native `f0009` visibly writes “luteal phase always 14 days”; treat ~14 days as an approximation, not an invariant or exact day-7/14/21 predictor.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain GnRH, FSH, LH, estradiol, progesterone and inhibin as distinct signals. The slide calls five “main” hormones before adding inhibin. GnRH is a releasing signal, not a molecular precursor of FSH/LH.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain pulsatile hypothalamic GnRH through portal circulation to **anterior-pituitary gonadotropes**. Native `f0020` labels the route correctly; caption at 09:39 says GnRH is produced in anterior pituitary, a spoken contradiction.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain FSH support of **already growing** follicles/granulosa; do not let one 28-day panel imply FSH initiates each primordial follicle's months-long development.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain LH stimulation of theca interna androgen production; native `f0024` labels theca interna and androstenedione. Source arrows are schematic, not concentrations or flux measurements.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain two-cell/two-gonadotropin mechanism: theca androgen diffuses to granulosa, FSH-supported aromatase produces estradiol. Native `f0026` has this compartment layout; differentiate ovarian follicle from uterus.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain estradiol negative feedback and inhibin contribution; source's low LH/FSH chart has no units or patient dataset. Do not claim absolute shutdown of secretion.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain sustained high estradiol-dependent positive feedback with pituitary/hypothalamic context, not a universal instantaneous scalar “threshold.” Native `f0038` illustrates a stylized switch; do not copy its curve as quantitative.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain LH surge → meiotic resumption, ovulation and luteinization. “36 h before” is approximate and depends on surge-onset/peak versus ovulation definition; day 14 is an example.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain granulosa inhibin suppression of FSH, but do not make it the sole cause of every FSH/LH amplitude difference. Caption “inevin” means inhibin.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain corpus luteum as luteinized granulosa **and theca** cells. Caption at 21:19 “no more granulosa cells” is biologically misleading; native `f0043` actually says granulosa become lutein cells. Luteal estradiol need not vanish.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain progesterone-rich luteal secretory endometrium; distinguish estradiol proliferation from progesterone differentiation, spiral-artery remodeling, and later placentation. “Endoneurium” at 22:41 is a caption error.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain implantation/placental trophoblast hCG rescue of corpus luteum. Native `f0051` and captions say “if fertilization occurs, embryo secretes hCG”; fertilization alone does not instantly produce a detectable urine hCG signal or guarantee rescue.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain secondary luteal estradiol rise; corpus luteum secretes both progesterone and estrogen. Source graph lacks axes/units, so teach direction and compartment, not measured amplitude.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain steroid withdrawal and shedding of endometrial functionalis. Avoid “no progesterone or estrogen” and universal heavy bleeding. **Retain late L46 exercise** at 28:50/native `f0059`: typical cycle duration, corpus-luteum role, and why the cycle matters.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain fertilization as gamete interaction and zygote formation; source's “mononucleated immediately” skips oocyte activation, meiosis-II completion and pronuclei. Native `f0007` shows a simplified gamete→zygote→fetus sequence, not the nuclear kinetics.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain ampulla as the **usual** human fertilization site; caption “always/every time” and direct ovary–tube uptake are overabsolute. Tubal ectopic location and assisted reproduction make “always” false.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain short oocyte fertilizable lifespan (roughly 12–24 h) and multi-day sperm survival with conditions; it contradicts L44's 14-day waiting claim (SCI-017). Native `f0011` says 48–72 h sperm, not a universal ceiling.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain severe sperm attrition as qualitative. Source switches “uterine cavity” and “uterine tube” and alleges the **uterine cavity** is highly acidic at 05:30; do not use that explanation or fixed 300–500 count. Vaginal acidity and cervical/tubal selection are different compartments.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain capacitation, cumulus/zona interaction and acrosome reaction in coherent order; source's egg-wide “chemoattraction,” hyaluronidase-only dissolution and enzymatic destruction of egg membranes are oversimplified. Native `f0014` confirms slide wording; species and in-vitro evidence should be labelled.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain sperm–oolemma fusion, Ca²⁺-linked activation, completion of oocyte meiosis II, pronuclear stages and diploid embryo; “sperm carries one egg” is a caption error. Do not draw membranes or nuclei as instantly fused without intermediate states.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain mammalian polyspermy barriers including cortical granule/zona modification and membrane-level change; the slide's “zona simply gets thicker and harder” is incomplete. Native `f0018` shows the drawn envelopes; it is not microscopy.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain cleavage → morula → blastocyst (trophoblast, inner cell mass, blastocoel) → hatching and endometrial apposition/adhesion/invasion. Native `f0025` and `f0028` show 8-cell versus 16–32-cell morula and days-after-fertilization labels. Caption “blastocyst diffuses into endometrium” at 13:23 is wrong mechanism. Cycle day ~14 and embryo age day 0 must be separate axes.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain usual 23+23 chromosomes, fertilization-related meiosis-II completion, and typical XX/XY chromosomal pattern, with exceptions to chromosomal development/phenotype. Do not call sex chromosomes a deterministic account of all sex development. Native `f0031` is black.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain amenorrhea, nausea, breast symptoms etc as **presumptive**, not diagnostic signs. Source's “pregnancy is 9 months and 7 days” mixes a dating convention with biological duration.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain ultrasound, appropriate cardiac-activity evaluation and hCG as differing tests at differing times. Native `f0038` calls Doppler 10–12 weeks and cardiac movement 4–8 weeks; the numbers require gestational-age and modality context, not an absolute milestone.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain urine hCG lateral-flow control/test lines. Native `f0040` sketches control + test versus blank; **missing control = invalid**, early control-only can be false negative. “All tests positive at 3–4 weeks” at 20:12 is untenable without gestational/fertilization clock and assay sensitivity. Trophoblast/placenta, not a free preimplantation embryo, is the clinically relevant hCG source.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain maternal cardiovascular, respiratory, renal, nutritional and breast adaptations with variable timing/magnitude. Avoid “kidney/bladder size” as a single uniform growth claim or a nutritional dose prescription.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain trimester overview with gestational-week axis and developmental variability. Native `f0047`/`f0051` slide says “37 weeks full term”: **37–38+6 is early term; 39–40+6 full term**. It also contains obvious “first trimester” text under third-trimester heading, so literal slide text is not reliable. Do not equate fetal position with head weight or make all 12-week sex visibility certain.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain Naegele as approximate **LMP-based** estimate, separate from fertilization age. Native `f0052` gives LMP 8 May 2009 → 15 Feb 2010 via +1 year −3 calendar months +7 days. Explain that calendar-month arithmetic is approximate relative to 280-day convention and assumes a regular 28-day cycle; dating ultrasound can revise it.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain uterine contractions, cervical effacement and dilation as distinct; native `f0054` shows 0 to 10 cm. Caption at 27:42 says “more than 10 to 15 centimeters”; **10 cm** is full dilation in standard obstetric staging.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain oxytocin/prostaglandin roles and cervical ripening; source's placental CRH/relaxin/estrogen as an exact human labor initiation chain is too deterministic. Native `f0056` labels roles, not direct causal proof; specify maternal–fetal–placental compartments if drawn.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain cord, placental separation/delivery and concern for retained tissue. Caption's placenta fragments “form a uterine tumor” at 28:49 is unsupported and should be removed; bleeding/infection are material risks. The source mixes cord clamping and third-stage placenta delivery sequence.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain cesarean as delivery through uterine and abdominal incisions, not just abdominal incision. Native `f0058`/`f0060` show a four-step stylized image; no surgical-procedure detail should be inferred from it.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

coverage_topics.disposition: Retain condition-specific indications (e.g. placenta previa, selected fetal compromise/breech), and individualized previous-cesarean counseling. Native `f0064`/`f0068` include the list. Do not assert every prior cesarean, multiple pregnancy, diabetes/BP problem needs surgery; or fixed 24–48 h labor, 30–60 min operation, 2–3 versus 10–14 d recovery, “equally safe” for all patients. Caption head-molding recovery in 30–40 min is too short. **Retain all five late L47 questions** at 33:45/native `f0069`: usual fertilization site; implantation; name of development in womb; final stage of pregnancy; colostrum. The last is a deliberate cross-chapter lactation bridge, despite no earlier L47 colostrum explanation. `f0070` is the closing credit/license statement.
coverage_topics.coverage_status: located in developed draft; author evidence, not review acceptance

realistic_asset_gate.scene_family: Endocrine cycle, fertilization/implantation, term placental compartments and labor sequence
realistic_asset_gate.rationale: Verified human hatching blastocyst light micrograph and human term-villus H&E supply directly relevant prepared appearance. Separate source-checked topology diagrams and controlled causal sequences preserve gamete/embryo locations and separate blood compartments without inventing photographic transport or labor timing.

limitations: Publisher captions and sampled slides are partial source evidence, not continuous audio/video.
The two micrographs are static prepared observations at distinct developmental stages; neither proves live dynamics or transport rates.
Controlled diagrams show conceptual order and compartment topology, not measured velocities, hormone concentrations or fetal outcomes.
Due dates and urine assay thresholds in code are synthetic teaching examples, not individual clinical advice.
coverage_basis: All36 L46–47 topics dispositioned using full captions and attributed bounded source still audit; exactly two actual independent full reviews and targeted union repair checks.
